_readme: Posting queue. Posts go out at their `at` time (UTC; 01:30Z = 07:00 IST, 13:30Z = 19:00 IST). A run posts the oldest due post that isn't on Instagram yet. Render with `npm run social:render`, commit and deploy before the time. Text in [[double brackets]] is highlighted. Never change the first caption line of a posted post: it's how duplicates are detected.

slides.sentence: With a quarter-point cut already [[priced in]], traders shrugged.

slides.meaning: One hundredth of a percentage point. 25 basis points = 0.25%.
Short-term bonds pay more than long-term ones, often read as a warning sign of recession.

slides.sentence: Analysts expect [[NIM]] to narrow next year.
slides.meaning: Net interest margin: what a bank earns on loans minus what it pays on deposits.

slides.sentence: The statement was a masterclass in [[forward guidance]].
